name: kuu-marketplace
description: Cursor plugin marketplace: CI auto-fix, plan digging, and task decomposition as Cursor Skills (auto-trigger).

plugins.name: fix-ci
plugins.description: Diagnose failing GitHub Actions checks on the current PR via gh CLI, explore logs/code with a read-only subagent, apply a minimal fix, push once, and summarize in the active plan.

plugins.name: dig
plugins.description: Stress-test a plan with assumption mapping and one structured question round; persist decisions to the active Cursor plan.

plugins.name: decomposition
plugins.description: Break a complex task into small, verifiable todos with rich descriptions and write them via the todo tool; append a summary to the active plan.
